args: Reassess the BLUE CREAM CHEESE carton from this noncontact observation pose, not the old rejected pinch. Request f0,f1 at two distinguishable printed top marks near an exposed long-axis end, away from the central pinch; describe their physical identities in mark_ids. Request f2,f3 on other well-spread top interior patches and t0,t1,t2 on adjacent bare table. Prefer the closer calibrated wrist view for these depths. Request s0,s1 on an exposed package sidewall if depth-valid; missing sidewall depths are allowed, but visually confirm a box wall extending toward this support. Return four cyclic visible top-boundary pixels in corners_uv, not edge-depth samples. Check the open-finger descent lane and a 75 mm upward test lane against neighboring objects. No hidden clearance claim. This is the first close measurement.

coarse_geometry.uncertainty_rule: max(1 mm working depth floor, two calibrated pixels at measured depth, three plane RMS); heuristic, not calibrated confidence

result.explanation: The current close wrist view resolves the blue cream cheese carton lying flat on the table, with its top unobscured. The earlier and current agent views show a short-end box wall extending down toward the table. No neighboring object visibly obstructs the local open-finger descent lane or the 75 mm upward test lane at this location. This is a local visual assessment, not approval of the previously rejected pinch or a hidden-clearance certificate.

mark_ids: f0: curved inner loop of the large initial capital C in Cream, near the upper short end.
f1: dark-blue upper-right scalloped logo lobe beside the beginning of Cream, below and right of f0.
parameters.notes: All selections use frame 96. f0/f1 are printed features near an exposed long-axis end, outside the central pinch. f2/f3 are separated lower top-interior patches; t0/t1/t2 are bare table. Corners are cyclic boundary pixels, not depth samples. s0/s1 are agentview short-end wall candidates; caller must check depth validity. The wrist wall is too thin for robust samples. Bowl, plate and rear platform appear separate from the local lane. Robot self-occlusion hides parts of bowl/platform; this is not observed external obstruction. Fresh depths must establish dimensions and finger/table margins. Hidden clearance and retention are not established.
